instruction: Push the T-shaped block to align it precisely with the gray T-shaped pad.

arguments.note: The blue T is right of the gray target and rotated relative to it. I will orient the right hand downward for a controlled table-level manipulation without lifting the block.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I am moving above the blue T while keeping clearance from the tabletop.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 13 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The approach landed accurately. I will finish turning straight down to see and engage the T at table height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 20 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will place the open jaws over the narrow stem, aligned to its sides, while remaining above contact.

arguments.note: The unobstructed wrist view shows a small settling offset and about five degrees of angular error. I will re-engage the stem at its settled angle for a final flat correction.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws are aligned with the settled stem. I will close at table height for the final small planar correction.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will rotate the T six degrees toward the pad and slide it four millimetres right and two millimetres forward, without changing height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The stem and pad are now parallel. I will make a final three-millimetre rightward and two-millimetre forward slide to center their outlines.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The gray stem border is now almost fully covered. I will release at table height and check that the T stays aligned.

arguments.note: The T remains over the pad after release. I will clear the empty hand vertically to inspect the complete placement before returning home.
